# Gumtree South Africa

> > South Africa's largest online classifieds marketplace connecting over 1 million users for buying, selling, and trading goods and services.

Gumtree South Africa provides a comprehensive platform for classified advertisements across multiple categories, with specialized tools for business advertisers including GAIT for auto dealers, ProTool for lead generation, and ShopMobile for mobile device trading. The platform serves both individual users and businesses with advanced inventory management and bulk listing capabilities.

## Key Topics

- Gumtree South Africa
- Online classifieds marketplace
- Business advertising solutions
- GAIT (Gumtree Auto Inventory Tool)
- ProTool lead generation
- ShopMobile mobile marketplace
- Auto inventory management
- Dealer dashboard
- Bulk listing tools
- Mobile device trading
- Samsung and Apple devices
- Vehicle listings
- Classified platform
- Business growth tools
- Featured deals

## Platform Overview

- [Gumtree South Africa](https://pages.gumtree.co.za/): Homepage for South Africa's largest online marketplace with 1M+ users

## Business Solutions

- [Gumtree For Business](https://pages.gumtree.co.za/gumtree-for-business): Business advertising platform with ProTool & GAIT for lead generation
- [GAIT - Gumtree Auto Inventory Tool](https://gait.gumtree.co.za/): Auto inventory management tool for vehicle listings & dealer platform

## Specialized Marketplaces

- [Buy Mobile Devices for Cash | ShopMobile Gumtree South Africa](https://shopmobile.gumtree.co.za/): Mobile phone marketplace featuring Apple, Samsung, Huawei & cash deals
